ambiguities.description: The transcript raises whether 'Customer' (CRM term) and 'Client' (billing system term) refer to the same object type. The Product Manager states they are the same concept for modeling purposes, but notes the billing team applies a stricter definition -- someone is only considered a 'client' once they have actually paid. This suggests 'Client' may actually be a subtype of Customer (e.g., a Customer who has made a payment) rather than a pure synonym, which is left unresolved.

source_references.excerpt: I've heard some people call customers "clients" in the billing system. Are those the same thing?

In our CRM they're "customers" but the billing team calls them "clients." For our purposes they're the same concept but the billing team has a slightly different definition -- they only consider someone a client once they've actually paid.

This uniqueness is inferred rather than stated.
